header.name: CMS8S78xx EPWM ACMP Brake Mode headless proof

steps.description: Drive P1.1 (pin 9, C0P0) to 0.10 (< 0.24 Bandgap threshold), ACMP0 output low
P3.3 (pin 27) initial low before ACMP comparator threshold crossing
Drive P1.1 (pin 9, C0P0) to 0.50 (> 0.24 Bandgap threshold), ACMP0 output high triggers fault brake
P3.3 (pin 27) transitions to 1 via Vector 18 IRQ when ACMP0 fault brake occurs
